newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VENEZUELA NOT TO PUSH FOR OPEC QUOTA ABANDONMENT.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA NOT TO PUSH FOR OPEC QUOTA ABANDONMENT.

text.p: Venezuelan oil minister Erwin Arrieta said on Monday it was not his country's aim to push for an abandonment of OPEC's quota system at this week's talks.
"No, we want to widen the spectrum to consider other aspects," he told reporters on arrival for the producer group's summer conference.
Arrieta was referring to a paper he put forward at the group's summer conference last year requesting a change in OPEC's strategy towards oil markets.
Last week Venezuela's state oil company president Luis Giusti had called for OPEC to scrap its quota system altogether in favour of a push for market share.
Venezuela is the producer group's biggest quota violator with production in May running at around 3.20 million barrels per day (bpd) compared with its quota of 2.359 million bpd.
Arrieta also reiterated his belief that the group would opt at this week's meeting for a rollover of its current 25.033 million bpd ceiling.
